claims: An 11-minute, 20-turn single conversation on battery in airplane mode completed with no crash or memory termination, a steady peak footprint of 5.73 GB and at least 0.71 GB always available.
The device stayed in the fair thermal state from about 1 minute on and never reached serious or critical; decode was paced at about 110 ms per token from the fourth turn on.

workload.prompts: 12 fixed prompts (English and Chinese) in a fixed order, one conversation
workload.environment: airplane mode, screen on at 50% brightness, unplugged, battery 85% at start, nominal thermal state at start, Release build

results.energy: not measurable: the reported battery level stayed at 85% for the whole run

pacing.policy: the generation loop waits so that a token takes at least 110 ms in the fair state and 200 ms in the serious or critical state; none in nominal
pacing.reason: once the device reaches serious it stays there for minutes even at reduced speed; with 92 ms pacing at fair, a plugged-in Debug run of the lut6 package reached serious at 484 s and stayed there 204 s (limit 120 s); with 110 ms the later runs, including this one, did not leave fair

limits.thermal: never critical; serious for at most 120 s continuously

cacheReuse.withoutThinking: a new prompt that extends exactly the cached tokens is fed incrementally; it fails when the chat template trims the assistant text and the generated tokens re-tokenize differently: about one turn in eight in development use, 2 of 19 in this run
cacheReuse.withThinking: the previous turn's thinking text is not kept in the history, so the prompt never extends the cached tokens and every turn re-prefills the conversation
